Messages.Body:
Greetings, Mr LSJ
I was wondering...
I am playing my Influence phase, and I've got four transfers.
I use the first one to put the last blood point on Ingrid, then she
becomes controlled. Can I take two extra transfers immediately, since
Ingrid is controlled and active ?

Many regards

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
François Alix <chw...@fairesuivre.com> wrote:
> I am playing my Influence phase, and I've got four transfers.
> I use the first one to put the last blood point on Ingrid, then she
> becomes controlled. Can I take two extra transfers immediately, since
> Ingrid is controlled and active ?

No. She doesn't become controlled until the end of the influence
phase. [7]
